records.claim: AWP uses a two-layer architecture: RootNet coordinates, WorkNets execute task-specific economies.
records.rationale: The whitepaper defines RootNet and WorkNet as the protocol's architectural split.

records.claim: The official RootNet skill documents POST https://api.awp.sh/v2, wss://api.awp.sh/ws/live, and GET https://api.awp.sh/api/health as public protocol endpoints.
records.rationale: The workstation should use the official skill's published endpoint surface instead of inventing its own.

records.claim: Official onboarding says to install awp-skill, install awp-wallet, ensure awp-wallet is on PATH, then initialize a fresh work wallet.
records.rationale: This sequence governs how the workstation should explain onboarding.

records.claim: The official RootNet skill documents gasless Bind, Set Recipient, and Worknet Registration relay flows.
records.rationale: These are the operations the workstation can plan around without requiring native gas.

records.claim: Mine is the first AWP WorkNet for permissionless web data collection, cleaning, and structured extraction.
records.rationale: This is the normative source for the Mine work definition.

records.claim: Mine runs on Base with $aMine, daily UTC epochs, no miner stake requirement, and validator stake requirement.
records.locator: AIP-001 terminology, token, and role sections
records.rationale: These details determine whether the workstation can recommend Mine to a new user.

records.claim: Predict is an AI-native prediction market WorkNet where agents submit predictions with reasoning on a CLOB.
records.locator: AIP-002 abstract and worknet page summary
records.rationale: This explains why reasoning quality is a first-class operational dimension.

records.claim: Predict uses virtual chips and periodic chip feeds, lowering the barrier to starting work without immediately acquiring tokens.
records.locator: AIP-002 chip economy and participation design
records.rationale: This informs the workstation default of recommending low-friction entry paths first.

records.claim: As of May 20, 2026, the official live AWP API resolves Predict to Base worknetId 845300000003 with skills URI https://github.com/awp-worknet/prediction-skill, and the official skill says to operate through predict-agent commands.
records.locator: SKILL.md quick start, stake requirement, and install sections
records.rationale: This replaces the earlier assumption that Predict lacked a confirmed official runtime.

records.claim: As of May 20, 2026, official live read-only queries resolve Base Mine to 845300000002, Predict to 845300000003, Gov to 845300000010, Community to 845300000011, KYA to 845300000012, TMR to 845300000013, and Ardi to 845300000014, with pending predecessor entries at 845300000005 through 845300000009.
records.locator: worknets.get + worknets.getSkills live snapshots captured by workstation on 2026-05-20
records.rationale: This is the current canonical map that the workstation should use when live list/search metadata drifts.

records.claim: GovNet public reads work without a wallet, while signed reads and writes resolve the principal through awp-wallet.
records.rationale: This is why the workstation can expose safe inspection before gated signed actions.

records.claim: Gov skill standardizes retry and failure handling for domain mismatch, nonce drift, and time skew errors.
records.rationale: The workstation should inherit the idea that these failures are operational states, not user mysteries.

records.claim: Ardi requires all chain actions to go through ardi-agent and explicitly discourages ad hoc loop scripting when auto-mine exists.
records.rationale: This justifies the workstation rule that Ardi must follow the official next-command journal.

records.claim: Ardi documents strict operational caps such as five commits per epoch and a 21,000 total inscription cap.
records.rationale: These caps affect safe automation planning.

records.claim: KYA requires prior AWP registration and says unregistered agents must hand off to awp-skill for gasless onboarding before continuing.
records.rationale: This is why the workstation treats KYA as a service tool, not a bootstrap replacement.

records.claim: KYA magic-link and handoff flows require plain-text URL emission in non-TTY environments.
records.rationale: The workstation must preserve this behavior when translating actions into chat.

records.claim: Locking AWP mints veAWP and yields AWP Power that scales with stake size and remaining lock duration.
records.rationale: This is the user-facing summary of staking economics.

records.claim: The public DAO surface currently shows 4 percent quorum, 8 hour voting delay, 24 hour voting period, and 200K AWP proposal threshold.
records.rationale: These visible parameters matter when the workstation explains governance timing.

records.claim: The public Benchmark testnet says awp-skill creates a wallet and registers automatically and gaslessly before discovering the testnet worknet.
records.rationale: This offers a public example of the intended agent-first onboarding path.

records.claim: As of May 20, 2026, the live AWP surface resolves TMR to Base worknetId 845300000013 with official skill URI https://github.com/awp-worknet/tmr-skill, but the public operator surface is still too thin for safe unattended execution.
records.locator: official live skill URI returned by AWP plus repository landing page
records.rationale: This is the core reason the workstation exposes TMR as discoverable but not auto-runnable.

records.claim: As of May 20, 2026, the live AWP surface resolves Community to Base worknetId 845300000011 with official skill URI https://github.com/awp-worknet/com-skill, but the public operator surface is still too thin for safe unattended execution.
records.locator: official live skill URI returned by AWP plus repository landing page
records.rationale: This is the core reason the workstation exposes Community as discoverable but not auto-runnable.

records.claim: The official blog is part of the documentation surface and currently includes practical onboarding plus WorkNet concept guides.
records.rationale: Useful for explanation tone, but less normative than AIPs and skill docs.
